description: This file defines the SaveWorkShiftController class within the OrangeHRM project, which handles the logic for rendering components related to work shift management (either editing an existing shift or creating a new one) by integrating with the framework's component and configuration services.

classes.name: SaveWorkShiftController
classes.description: Controller responsible for preparing the Vue component for either editing or creating a work shift based on request attributes.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component based on whether an 'id' attribute is present in the request. If present, sets up the component for editing; otherwise, sets up for creating a new shift with default times.
